worldcombat.skill.icespinner.summary: Covers its feet in thin ice and spins into the target: the spin sweeps terrains out of its path, leaves a short-lived ice trail on the ground, and settles ice contact damage while shoving the target away.
worldcombat.skill.icespinner.use.0: Drive into a grounded target and shove it away
worldcombat.skill.icespinner.use.1: Sweep away the terrain a foe is relying on
worldcombat.skill.icespinner.use.2: Leave a short-lived ice trail across the ground
worldcombat.skill.icespinner.description: Spins along the ground for %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick; on contact it settles %3$s ice contact damage.
The spin sweeps every terrain within %1$s blocks of its path; the hit radius is %2$s blocks and a hit shoves the target %3$s blocks.
The spin lays %1$s cells of ice that last %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.icespinner.slick.on: Ice-slick mode: reach x1.25, spin speed x1.2, ice lasts x1.5 and knockback x0.7 for a longer, slipperier ride, at the cost of x0.85 main power.
worldcombat.skill.icespinner.slick.off: Shard mode: main power x1.15, sweep radius x1.3 and knockback x1.4 for a harsher spin, at the cost of x0.8 reach, x0.6 ice duration and +2 ticks wind-up.
worldcombat.skill.icespinner.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.icespinner.growth.0: From level %1$s the spin rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of reach.
worldcombat.skill.icespinner.growth.1: From level %1$s the spin rises to %2$s power.
On: reach x1.25, spin speed x1.2, ice lasts x1.5 and knockback x0.7 for a longer, slipperier ride, at the cost of x0.85 main power. Off (shards): main power x1.15, sweep radius x1.3 and knockback x1.4 for a harsher spin, at the cost of x0.8 reach, x0.6 ice duration and +2 ticks wind-up.
The companion only spins toward a target within this distance; larger values let it commit from further out.
On: targets carrying a terrain identity rank higher, so the spin sweeps it away on the way. Off: ordinary melee ordering.
